name: RovGrid | Tevah Vault Rigorous Completion Audit

full_core.definition: Seven source cards needed together to establish one 100%-arithmetic box construction; they are stages, not separate complete boxes.

partial.definition: התאמה מוגדרת לממד, לפאה או לנגזרת של התיבה, בלי סגירת שלושת הממדים ופאותיהם באותו אובייקט

support.definition: הישג אנטומי, ביולוגי או סמלי שנשמר בכספת, אך אינו חלק מהוכחת תיבה שלמה ואינו פאה חדשה

full_definition.standard: One explicitly declared set of adult anatomical inventories with dimensions 8,20,26; computed pairwise values exactly 160,208,520; sum 888; cubic triple product 4160; cross-check all three face-times-opposite-dimension products. This is a complete arithmetic research model, not a literal box found in anatomy.

anatomical_inventories.bones: Cranial neurocranium bones: frontal1, parietals2, temporals2, occipital1, sphenoid1, ethmoid1
Metacarpals: five per hand×2=10; metatarsals: five per foot×2=10; 20 metacarpal/metatarsal bones in total
Adult spine: 7 cervical+12 thoracic+5 lumbar+1 fused sacrum+1 fused coccyx=26

conditions: All three starting inventories declared and counted without duplicate bone
All three pairwise products computed and match 160,208,520
All three opposite dimension identities independently computed
Only one award per unique triple/inventory configuration, not one award per algebraic step

molecular_three_precursor_match.statement: 160, 208, 520 amino acids in three different human canonical precursor sequences. All three face values are observed, and they sum to 888 arithmetically, but these proteins are independent molecules with no demonstrated anatomical dimension triple 8/20/26; therefore they are THREE PARTIAL CARDS and ZERO full-box awards.
molecular_three_precursor_match.note: Canonical precursor/full sequence lengths only; mature processed chains or alternate isoforms differ.

safety_for_film: Never say there are seven independent anatomical boxes: there is one complete arithmetic construction recorded through seven stages.
The 8,20,26 inventories are distinct bone categories, not three measured physical edges of an anatomical solid.
Avoid equating proteasome 20S/26S or mitoribosome 55S/28S sedimentation labels with subunit counts.
Human embryonic genome activation has an important 8-cell phase, but transcription can already start at 1-cell stage.
Partial DNA orbit class counts are combinatorial string counts, not actual gene numbers.
Items without box anchors remain in support tier; they cannot increase the box-completion counter.

external_sources.note: Evidence transcription begins at one-cell stage
